description.zh: 证书ID，多个证书ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为[ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~)返回的**CertificateId**。
description.en: The ID of the certificate. Separate multiple certificate IDs with commas (,). You can call the [ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~) operation to obtain the ID of a certificate from the **CertificateId** parameter.

description.zh: 联系人ID。多个联系人ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为[ListContact](~~2712221~~)返回的主键**Id**。
description.en: The ID of the contact. Separate multiple contact IDs with commas (,). You can call the [ListContact](~~2712221~~) operation to obtain the ID of a contact from the **ContactId** parameter.

description.zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为[CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~)返回的任务ID。也可通过[ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the deployment task. You can call the [CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~) operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task from the JobId parameter. You can also call the [ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~) operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task.
The name of the deployment task.

description.zh: 云产品资源ID。多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为[ListCloudResources](~~2712230~~)返回的主键**Id**。
description.en: The ID of the cloud resource. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,). You can call the [ListCloudResources](~~2712230~~) operation to obtain the ID of a cloud resource from the **Id** parameter.

description.zh: 设置任务开始调度的时间（Unix时间戳）。如果不设置，默认创建任务后立即执行部署。
description.en: The time when the task starts. The value is a UNIX timestamp. If you do not specify this parameter, the system immediately starts the task after it is created.
